newsitem.title: UK: Fast drunk jailed for 12 months in Britain.
newsitem.headline: Fast drunk jailed for 12 months in Britain.

text.p: A drunk fashion designer was jailed for 12 months on Friday after driving at 100 mph the wrong way down a British motorway.
Anil Mane had taken a cocktail of morphine, paracetamol and alcohol for toothache. Cars and lorries were forced to swerve out of his way, a court in Leeds, northern England, heard.
When he finally crashed and was arrested by police he thought he was 250 miles away in Sussex.
"The defendant was drunk. He couldn't talk or stand," prosecutor Sarah Wright told the court.
Mane was also banned from driving for four years after pleading guilty to dangerous driving, failing to provide a breath specimen and driving while unfit through drink and drugs.
